chapter: Charlie Johnson, Willie Gant and the late 1920s
title: Willie Gant, an overlooked stride pianist
summary: Willie Gant never recorded much, played cocktail piano at Rudy's, and was a stride player in the class of Fats and Willie the Lion.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: He just died about a year and a half ago, two years ago.
: We never get anything much on him, you know, because nobody knows. I mean what sort of piano player was he?
Good swing. He was in that group with like Fats and --
: I mean he just seemed to get short-changed in all the stories.
Well, he got that job down at Rudy's down there on Madison Avenue. He was down there for years after he, you know, he --
: What was he playing (unintelligible), cocktail piano, yeah.
Cocktail and a little singing, but he was one of them swing piano players, you know, like Fats.
Oh, yeah, he was good. He was -- he
could play up to a lot of them fellows, that's true. Knowledge (Unintelligible) used to have what they called the cutting contest.
